title: Titanium Sulfuric Acid Injection Quill
function: Dosing injection quill for sulfuric acid (Grade 7)
alloyReason: Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni (UNS R53400) is selected for this reactor hardware chemical processing application where HCl/H2SO4 resistance up to 200C is required beyond CP grades. Mo+Ni stabilize the passive film in crevice conditions. This rationale is driven by dosing injection quill for sulfuric acid (grade 7) and fat life requirements.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for reactor hardware geometry
CNC corrosion allowance with SPC sampling
TIG welding Grade 2 with SPC sampling
Hydrostatic shell test with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for dosing injection quill application
commonFailures: Pitting in stagnant HCl above 60C - requires Grade 12 for Mo-enhanced passive film stability — critical for dosing injection quill performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Sulfuric Acid Injection Quill suitable for Dosing injection quill for sulfuric acid (Grade 7)?
faq.a: Titanium Sulfuric Acid Injection Quill uses Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address reactor hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Sulfuric Acid Injection Quill?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Sulfuric Acid Injection Quill is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for dosing injection quill requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Sulfuric Acid Injection Quill require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. dosing injection quill components require Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for dosing injection quill application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Sulfuric Acid Injection Quill shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Sulfuric Acid Injection Quill includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet dosing injection quill specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
